description: List AI memory items. Scope a note with entity ('lead'|'contact'|'account'|'campaign') + entity_id (the record id). With entity_id: that record's notes PLUS tenant-wide notes. Without: tenant-wide only. category is now a free topical label (e.g. 'positioning-usp') you can filter on. To read a campaign's playbook memory, pass entity='campaign', entity_id=<campaign_id>. (Legacy: parent_id is an alias for entity_id.) Newest first; each row includes entity/entity_id/created_at/updated_at and a computed scope.

entity_id.description: Record id the notes are attached to

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_ai_memory_items
